# stalwart_security (Data Source)

Configures automatic IP banning rules for abuse, authentication failures, and port scanning. This singleton object always exists: creating the resource adopts the current server settings and destroying it only removes the resource from state.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `abuse_ban_period` (Number) The duration of the ban for abuse attempts
- `abuse_ban_rate` (Attributes) The maximum number of abuse attempts (relaying or failed RCPT TO attempts) before the IP is banned (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--abuse_ban_rate))
- `auth_ban_period` (Number) The duration of the ban for failed login attempts
- `auth_ban_rate` (Attributes) The maximum number of failed login attempts before the IP is banned (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--auth_ban_rate))
- `id` (String) Always `singleton`.
- `loiter_ban_period` (Number) The duration of the ban for loitering connections.
- `loiter_ban_rate` (Attributes) The maximum number of loitering disconnections before the IP is banned (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--loiter_ban_rate))
- `scan_ban_paths` (Set of String) The paths that will trigger an immediate ban if accessed. Each path should be a glob expression
- `scan_ban_period` (Number) The duration of the ban for port scanning attempts
- `scan_ban_rate` (Attributes) The maximum number of port scanning attempts before the IP is banned (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--scan_ban_rate))
